name: Broccoli Casserole
description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side

_similar.name: Supreme Broccoli Soup Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole with a crunchy crouton topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Place cooked broccoli in a 9x9 inch pan.
Mix together mushroom soup, flour, sour cream, and seasonings. Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle grated carrot, chopped onion, and croutons over the top.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325°F for 1/2 hour.

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Cauliflower Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A versatile casserole recipe that can use either cauliflower or broccoli, topped with croutons and Parmesan cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the chosen vegetable in the microwave for 2 minutes.
Add cream of celery soup, mayonnaise, and cheese to the cooked vegetable. Mix well.
Add croutons to the mixture.
Spread cracker crumbs on top of the casserole.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the mixture.
Put butter pieces on top of the mixture.
Cook at 350°F for 40 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cauliflower casserole, broccoli casserole, cheesy vegetable bake
